Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner fixed on Lebanon as “the region immediately north of Israel,” ignoring the second clue (“the location of Operation Earnest Will,” i.e., the Persian Gulf) that points to Iraq—the country bordering the Gulf and whose independence/establishment was in 1932. This misinterpretation set the search down the Lebanon track (1920/1943) instead of Iraq (1932), directly causing the wrong solution.
